programme.desc: 「解决师」协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson(王浩信饰)，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe(张曦雯饰)一起，可惜Chole意外死亡。K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生。5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣(唐诗咏饰)，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命。

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth stet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The stet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their sarate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains.

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生(谭俊彦饰)、沈敬一(陈山聪饰)、谢家富(何远东饰)等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还。十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾(黄智雯饰)萌生情愫，内心更为困惑。与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进(林嘉华饰)亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连。随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: The Justice Of Life
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancee during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like

programme.title: 他来自江湖
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生。明天与母亲、舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结。明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪。鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋。

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career kes progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because

programme.title: 香港人在北京
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁(陈展鹏饰)藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦(吴若希饰)误堕投资骗局，损失惨重。港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机。港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲(蔡洁饰)，婚姻面临考验。美食网红徐港文(洪永城饰)、街头歌手徐宝怡(戴祖仪饰)各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园。「佛系主义」的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: The Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭、杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇。郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺。一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇。机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进。那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子。

programme.title: The Man Who Kills Troubles
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and

programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁(陈展鹏饰)藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦(吴若希饰)误堕投资骗局，损失惨重。港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机。港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲(蔡洁饰)，婚姻面临考验。美食网红徐港文(洪永城饰)、街头歌手徐宝怡(戴祖仪饰)各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园。「佛系主义」的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: The Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭、杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇。郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺。一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇。机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进。那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子。

programme.title: The Man Who Kills Troubles
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and

programme.title: 解决师
programme.desc: 「解决师」协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson(王浩信饰)，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe(张曦雯饰)一起，可惜Chole意外死亡。K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生。5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣(唐诗咏饰)，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命。

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth stet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The stet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their sarate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains.

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生(谭俊彦饰)、沈敬一(陈山聪饰)、谢家富(何远东饰)等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还。十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾(黄智雯饰)萌生情愫，内心更为困惑。与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进(林嘉华饰)亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连。随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: The Justice Of Life
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancee during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. programme.title: 他来自江湖
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生。明天与母亲、舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结。明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪。鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋。

programme.desc: 「解决师」协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson(王浩信饰)，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe(张曦雯饰)一起，可惜Chole意外死亡。K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生。5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣(唐诗咏饰)，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命。

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth stet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The stet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their sarate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains.

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生(谭俊彦饰)、沈敬一(陈山聪饰)、谢家富(何远东饰)等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还。十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾(黄智雯饰)萌生情愫，内心更为困惑。与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进(林嘉华饰)亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连。随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: The Justice Of Life
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancee during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like

programme.title: 他来自江湖
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生。明天与母亲、舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结。明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪。鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋。

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career kes progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because

programme.title: 香港人在北京
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁(陈展鹏饰)藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦(吴若希饰)误堕投资骗局，损失惨重。港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机。港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲(蔡洁饰)，婚姻面临考验。美食网红徐港文(洪永城饰)、街头歌手徐宝怡(戴祖仪饰)各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园。「佛系主义」的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: The Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭、杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇。郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺。一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇。机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进。那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子。

programme.title: The Man Who Kills Troubles
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and

The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭、杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇。郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺。一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇。机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进。那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子。

programme.title: The Man Who Kills Troubles
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and

programme.title: 解决师
programme.desc: 「解决师」协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson(王浩信饰)，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe(张曦雯饰)一起，可惜Chole意外死亡。K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生。5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣(唐诗咏饰)，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命。

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth stet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The stet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their sarate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains.

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生(谭俊彦饰)、沈敬一(陈山聪饰)、谢家富(何远东饰)等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还。十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾(黄智雯饰)萌生情愫，内心更为困惑。与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进(林嘉华饰)亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连。随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: The Justice Of Life
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancee during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like

programme.title: 他来自江湖
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生。明天与母亲、舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结。明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪。鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋。

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career kes progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because

programme.title: 香港人在北京
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁(陈展鹏饰)藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦(吴若希饰)误堕投资骗局，损失惨重。港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机。港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲(蔡洁饰)，婚姻面临考验。美食网红徐港文(洪永城饰)、街头歌手徐宝怡(戴祖仪饰)各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园。「佛系主义」的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生(谭俊彦饰)、沈敬一(陈山聪饰)、谢家富(何远东饰)等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还。十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾(黄智雯饰)萌生情愫，内心更为困惑。与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进(林嘉华饰)亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连。随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: The Justice Of Life
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancee during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like

programme.title: 他来自江湖
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生。明天与母亲、舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结。明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪。鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋。

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career kes progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because

programme.title: 香港人在北京
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁(陈展鹏饰)藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦(吴若希饰)误堕投资骗局，损失惨重。港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机。港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲(蔡洁饰)，婚姻面临考验。美食网红徐港文(洪永城饰)、街头歌手徐宝怡(戴祖仪饰)各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园。「佛系主义」的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: The Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭、杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇。郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺。一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇。机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进。那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子。

programme.title: The Man Who Kills Troubles
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and

programme.title: 解决师
programme.desc: 「解决师」协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson(王浩信饰)，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe(张曦雯饰)一起，可惜Chole意外死亡。K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生。5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣(唐诗咏饰)，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命。

programme.title: Life After Death
programme.desc: Seven years ago, a serious car accident shattered two families and changed the lives of Jiang Yucheng (Frankie Lam) and Fang Lewen (Priscilla Wong). Seven years later, another traffic accident brings Yucheng back to Lewen, and life continues with its share of joys and sorrows. Lewen and her sister Fang Shuwen (Shiga Lin) have a falling out as those around them leave one by one, but the eccentric doctor Gu Xichen (Ma Guandong) manages to get to the root of the problem. Lewen is busy taking care o

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚(林文龙饰)、方乐汶(黄翠如饰)的人生。七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜。乐汶与妹妹方书文(连诗雅饰)因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨(马贯东饰)，却能直捣问题根源。乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳(顾定轩饰)，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优(苏皓儿饰)的需要。子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦(李任燊饰)竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变......

programme.title: Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: Food supplier LO KAI-FONG (Kitty Yuen) is a short, average, thirtysomething dating virgin, and she serendipitously helps a young restaurateur, LAU PAK-YIP (Jason Chan), overcome adversity, making this drop-dead gorgeous uncover and value her inner beauty. Gradually, their love grows, which KAI-FONG's neighbour and best friend, KO KWAI-FUN (Samantha Ko), cannot let go of. Though fish peddler KWAI-FUN, whose beauty resembles a stunning diva, tries every means possible to flirt with PAK-YIP, she

programme.title: 爱情食物链
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳(阮小仪)样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业(陈智燊)渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬(高海宁)对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻(金刚)的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高(郑子诚)，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾......

programme.title: Justice Sung Begins
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of the Qing era, due to his father Sung On (Cheung Tat Ming) working as a prison guard, smart and clever Sung Sai-kit (Vincent Wong) has witnessed all kinds of unjust things as he has been wandering around within the prison walls since his childhood, causing him not to believe there is justice in the legal field. After reaching adulthood, Sai-kit also does not want to become an imperial official even though he is well educated. He just covertly helps a fellow student called Ho

programme.title: 状王之王
programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰(王浩信饰)因父亲宋安(张达明饰)是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义。世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信(林子聪饰)中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九(金刚饰)浪游天下。世杰及后却被卷进「蜘蛛精杀人案」中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑(姚子羚饰)......案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案......

programme.title: Will Power
programme.desc: At court, two of the most famous lawyers in town YU YING-WAI (Wayne Lai) and LEE MING-YEUNG (Moses Chan) conduct tit-for-tat attacks on each other by any means necessary. YING-WAI eventually turns the tide before he is defeated, however, he almost loses his life in the process, which completely alters his perspective on life. Such change catches a Senior Counsel LO SUM-PO's (Yueh Hua) eye, and he recruits YING-WAI to handle a litigation regarding the will of a late tycoon.

programme.title: 法外风云
programme.desc: 城中两大名嘴律师余英伟(黎耀祥)和李名扬(陈豪)在法庭上各施奇谋，针锋相对，英伟反败为胜却差点丧命，令他重新审视人生，他的转变令资深律师卢琛保(岳华)另眼相看，招揽英伟加盟处理一宗富豪遗产案

YING-WAI eventually turns the tide before he is defeated, however, he almost loses his life in the process, which completely alters his perspective on life. Such change catches a Senior Counsel LO SUM-PO's (Yueh Hua) eye, and he recruits YING-WAI to handle a litigation regarding the will of a late tycoon.

programme.title: 法外风云
programme.desc: 城中两大名嘴律师余英伟(黎耀祥)和李名扬(陈豪)在法庭上各施奇谋，针锋相对，英伟反败为胜却差点丧命，令他重新审视人生，他的转变令资深律师卢琛保(岳华)另眼相看，招揽英伟加盟处理一宗富豪遗产案

programme.title: Life After Death
programme.desc: Seven years ago, a serious car accident shattered two families and changed the lives of Jiang Yucheng (Frankie Lam) and Fang Lewen (Priscilla Wong). Seven years later, another traffic accident brings Yucheng back to Lewen, and life continues with its share of joys and sorrows. Lewen and her sister Fang Shuwen (Shiga Lin) have a falling out as those around them leave one by one, but the eccentric doctor Gu Xichen (Ma Guandong) manages to get to the root of the problem. Lewen is busy taking care o

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚(林文龙饰)、方乐汶(黄翠如饰)的人生。七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜。乐汶与妹妹方书文(连诗雅饰)因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨(马贯东饰)，却能直捣问题根源。乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳(顾定轩饰)，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优(苏皓儿饰)的需要。子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦(李任燊饰)竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变......

programme.title: Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: Food supplier LO KAI-FONG (Kitty Yuen) is a short, average, thirtysomething dating virgin, and she serendipitously helps a young restaurateur, LAU PAK-YIP (Jason Chan), overcome adversity, making this drop-dead gorgeous uncover and value her inner beauty. Gradually, their love grows, which KAI-FONG's neighbour and best friend, KO KWAI-FUN (Samantha Ko), cannot let go of. Though fish peddler KWAI-FUN, whose beauty resembles a stunning diva, tries every means possible to flirt with PAK-YIP, she

programme.title: 爱情食物链
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳(阮小仪)样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业(陈智燊)渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬(高海宁)对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻(金刚)的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高(郑子诚)，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾......

programme.title: Justice Sung Begins
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of the Qing era, due to his father Sung On (Cheung Tat Ming) working as a prison guard, smart and clever Sung Sai-kit (Vincent Wong) has witnessed all kinds of unjust things as he has been wandering around within the prison walls since his childhood, causing him not to believe there is justice in the legal field. After reaching adulthood, Sai-kit also does not want to become an imperial official even though he is well educated. He just covertly helps a fellow student called Ho

programme.title: 状王之王
programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰(王浩信饰)因父亲宋安(张达明饰)是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义。世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信(林子聪饰)中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九(金刚饰)浪游天下。世杰及后却被卷进「蜘蛛精杀人案」中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑(姚子羚饰)......案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案......

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚(林文龙饰)、方乐汶(黄翠如饰)的人生。七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜。乐汶与妹妹方书文(连诗雅饰)因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨(马贯东饰)，却能直捣问题根源。乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳(顾定轩饰)，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优(苏皓儿饰)的需要。子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦(李任燊饰)竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变......

programme.title: 爱情食物链
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳(阮小仪)样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业(陈智燊)渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬(高海宁)对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻(金刚)的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高(郑子诚)，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾......
